'''Krashilok''' was the pet [[pritarr]] owned by [[Beast-Lord]] [[Akoru]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. During the [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|mission to Onderon]] Akoru ordered Krashilok to attack those who intruded upon his lair, but the pritarr was killed by the intruders instead. According to [[C2-D4]], "Krashilok" was actually a clever pun in the ancient Onderonian language.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=location|Onderon}}</ref>
